Title: Create an order with a customer photo upload failure and verify no orphaned files remain
Preconditions: User is logged in and has a valid shop selected. MinIO storage is configured but set to simulate upload failures for customer photos.
Steps:
1. Navigate to the 'Create Order' screen. 2. Enter valid customer details (name, phone, gender). 3. Upload a customer photo that will fail (e.g., simulate a network error or invalid file). 4. Complete the order creation by adding at least one item and setting all required fields. 5. Submit the order. 6. Verify the error message is displayed. 7. Check the MinIO storage bucket for any orphaned customer photo files.

Test Data: Customer photo: simulate upload failure (e.g., use a file that triggers a network error or invalid response from MinIO).
Expected Result: The system displays an error message indicating the customer photo upload failed. The order is not created. No orphaned customer photo files are present in MinIO storage.
